visualCharacteristics: White rounded cards overlapping the bottom of the hero; 4x2 grid (2 columns on mobile) of icon + label tiles with a 'Veja mais' link. Option 'compact': short tiles with the icon beside the label and no 'Veja mais' affordance, for secondary service lists.
contentPattern: One row per tile. Cell 1: icon (:icon-name: or SVG image). Cell 2: label as linked text, optional 'Veja mais' link.
usage: Home page quick service tiles (Falta de Energia, Fatura Digital, Consulta protocolo, Troca de titularidade, Pedido de nova ligacao, Pedido de religacao, Segunda via, Parcelamento).
reuseGuidance: Use for grids of short service shortcuts with an icon, a linked label and an optional secondary link. Place a centered 'Mais Servicos' button after the block in the same section (section style: centered).
